description: This file defines the PageSetup class used for reading and applying page setup configurations from Gnumeric spreadsheet files into PhpSpreadsheet's internal data structures. It handles settings such as print information, page margins, orientation, and page order.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: A class for reading and applying page setup configurations from Gnumeric spreadsheet files into the PhpSpreadsheet object model.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PageSetup object with a reference to the target Spreadsheet.

methods.name: printInformation
methods.description: Reads print information from a Gnumeric XML element and applies settings such as print scale, page order, orientation, and centered margins.

methods.name: sheetMargins
methods.description: Reads margin information from a Gnumeric XML element and applies margins to the active sheet.

methods.name: buildMarginSet
methods.description: Constructs an array of margin values by reading from the XML element, converting points to inches.

methods.name: adjustMargins
methods.description: Adjusts margins based on Gnumeric's quirky header/footer display logic.

methods.name: sheetMargin
methods.description: Sets the specific margin (top, bottom, left, right, header, footer) on the active sheet.
